1. docker-log-rotation  [networking]  fixes DKR-031
   Rotate json-file container logs (max-size 10m, max-file 3) in daemon.json
   opt in: applied only when selected by id
   create   /etc/docker/daemon.json (0644)
            checked first with: dockerd --validate --config-file <new file>
            --- /dev/null
            +++ b/etc/docker/daemon.json
            @@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
            +{
            +  "log-driver": "json-file",
            +  "log-opts": {
            +    "max-size": "10m",
            +    "max-file": "3"
            +  }
            +}
   run      systemctl restart docker
            # load the new log settings
   restarts docker
   note     Restarting Docker stops and starts every container unless live-restore is on; containers without a restart policy stay stopped.
   note     The limits apply to containers created after the restart; recreate running containers (for example docker compose up -d --force-recreate) to rotate their logs.
   undo     Remove daemon.json, which did not exist before, and restart Docker.
            rm -f /etc/docker/daemon.json
            systemctl restart docker
